verdict.rationale: Foreloop collects raw feedback through a widget and triages each submission as real or spam/noise, dismissing spam. An agent then reads each real submission, fills in an intention and proposes tasks, which covers the declutter half of the story. Nothing shows AI aggregating, ranking or prioritizing feedback across submissions to surface the most impactful opportunities. missing for 10: cross-feedback clustering/deduplication, impact-based prioritization or ranking of opportunities, explicit confirmation that spam triage is AI-driven, independent or hands-on corroboration.
